chunks: My father narrated to me, from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh, from Muḥammad ibn Ḥusain ibn Abil Khaťťāb, and Muḥammad ibn Ja’far Al-Razzāz narrated to me, from Muḥammad ibn Ḥusain ibn Abil Khaťťāb, from some of his companions, from Juwayriyah ibn ‘Alā, from some of his companions, from Abū ‘Abdillāh (peace be upon him) who said:

On the Day of Judgment, a caller will call out, 'Where are the visitors of Ḥusain ibn ‘Ali (peace be upon him)?' So a large number of people, who cannot be counted by anyone other than Allāh, the Exalted, will stand. Then He will ask them, 'What was your intention in visiting the grave of Ḥusain (peace be upon him)?' They will reply, 'O Lord! We went to him out of love for the Messenger of Allāh and out of love for ‘Ali and Fāťimah, and out of sympathy for him because of that which was committed against him.' It will be said to them, 'Here are Muḥammad, ‘Ali, Fāťimah, Ḥasan, and Ḥusain (peace be upon them). Join them, for you will be with them at their level. Follow the flag of the Messenger of Allāh.' Therefore, they will go to the flag of the Messenger of Allāh, which will be in the hand of ‘Ali (peace be upon him), and they will remain under its shade—until all of them enter Paradise. They will be in front of the flag, to its right, to its left, and behind it.

key_terms.لِوَاءُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: The banner/flag of the Messenger of God

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting the grave of Imam Husain on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, this hadith establishes the theological link between visiting Imam Ḥusain (a.s.) and the ultimate intercession of the Ahl al-Bayt, emphasizing that such devotion is an extension of love for the Prophet and his family. The narrative highlights the eschatological role of the Banner (Liwa') held by ‘Ali (a.s.), under whose shade the visitors are granted entry to Paradise, reinforcing the Shia concept of *tawassul* through the Imams. This reward structure underscores that the physical act of ziyarah is validated by the spiritual intention of love (*hubb*) and compassion (*rahmah*) for the Ahl al-Bayt's suffering.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 1. My father narrated to me from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh, from Muḥammad ibn Ḥusain ibn Abil Khaťťāb, from some of his companions, from Juwayriyah ibn ‘Alā, from some of his companions, who said: Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said:

On the Day of Judgment, a caller will call out, “Where are the Zuwwār of Ḥusain ibn ‘Ali (a.s.)?” So a large number of people, who cannot be counted by anyone other than Allāh, the Exalted, will stand. Then Allāh will ask them, “What made you go to the Ziyārah of the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.)?” They will reply, “O Lord! We went to him because of our love for the Messenger of Allāh (s.a.a.w.) and because of our love for ‘Ali and Fāťimah (a.s.) and to sympathize with him because of that which was committed against him.” They will be told, “Here are Muḥammad, ‘Ali, Fāťimah, Ḥasan, and Ḥusain (a.s.). Join them, for you will be with them at their level (in Paradise). Follow the flag of the Messenger of Allāh (s.a.a.w.).” Therefore, they will go to the flag of the Messenger of Allāh (s.a.a.w.) which will be held by ‘Ali (a.s.) and they will remain under its shade, in front of it, to its right, to its left, and behind it until all of them enter Paradise. The above Ḥadīth has also been narrated to me through the following chain: Muḥammad ibn Ja’far Al-Razzāz, from Muḥammad ibn Ḥusain ibn Abil Khaťťāb, from some of his companions, from Juwayriyah ibn ‘Alā, from some of his companions, from Abī ‘Abdillāh (a.s.).
